name: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

nodes.name: Fetch Remote OK
nodes.notes: Remote OK public JSON API. Returns array of jobs. First item is metadata, skip it.

nodes.name: Fetch Remotive
nodes.notes: Remotive public API — no auth needed. Pulls up to 150 jobs across relevant categories.

nodes.name: Fetch We Work Remotely
nodes.notes: WWR RSS feed. Covers all remote categories.

nodes.name: Fetch Wellfound
nodes.notes: Wellfound has no public API. This hits their public search page. You may need to update the URL or use a scraping service. Alternatively replace with Apify actor for Wellfound.

nodes.name: Tag Wellfound Source
nodes.notes: Wellfound returns HTML — parse job listings from the page. Update regex patterns if site structure changes. Consider replacing with Apify actor for reliable scraping.

nodes.name: Fetch Himalayas
nodes.notes: Himalayas RSS feed for remote jobs.

nodes.name: Fetch Dynamite Jobs
nodes.notes: Dynamite Jobs RSS feed.

nodes.name: Fetch YC Work at Startup
nodes.notes: YC Work at a Startup API endpoint for remote jobs. Filter by remote=true.

nodes.name: Tag YC Source
nodes.notes: YC returns HTML. This node attempts to extract jobs from JSON embedded in the page or a structured response.

nodes.name: Fetch Otta
nodes.notes: Otta has no public API or RSS. This uses their public search. You may need an Apify actor or manual check. Replace URL if Otta updates their site structure.

nodes.name: Merge Group A
nodes.notes: Combines Remote OK + Remotive

nodes.name: Merge Group B
nodes.notes: Combines We Work Remotely + Wellfound

nodes.name: Merge Group C
nodes.notes: Combines Himalayas + Dynamite Jobs

nodes.name: Merge Group D
nodes.notes: Combines YC + Otta

nodes.name: Merge All Sources
nodes.notes: Final merge of all 4 groups into one stream.

nodes.name: Normalize Job Data
nodes.notes: Normalizes all job formats into a standard schema: job_title, company, job_url, source, location_text, salary, description, posted_date, tags, job_id.

nodes.name: Read Existing Job URLs
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Set documentId to your Google Sheet ID. Sheet name: 'Raw Jobs'. This reads all existing job_url values for deduplication.

nodes.name: Deduplicate Jobs
nodes.notes: Compares new jobs against existing Google Sheets data. Deduplicates by job_url first, then company+job_title as backup key.

nodes.name: Write Raw Jobs
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Set documentId to your Google Sheet ID. Appends all deduplicated jobs to 'Raw Jobs' sheet before any filtering.

nodes.name: Hard Taiwan Filter
nodes.notes: Keyword-based hard reject of jobs that are clearly country-restricted, onsite, hybrid, or fixed-hours. Faster than AI for obvious cases.

nodes.name: Prepare AI Prompt
nodes.notes: Wraps job data + AI prompt into a single item so original job data survives the OpenAI API call.

nodes.name: AI Taiwan Eligibility Check
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Create an 'OpenAI API' credential in n8n. Uses gpt-4o-mini for cost efficiency. Switch to gpt-4o for higher accuracy. The node sends a JSON body with the system + user prompts.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0, max_tokens: 300, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json._system_prompt }, { role: 'user', content: $json._user_content }] }) }}

nodes.name: Parse AI Response
nodes.notes: Extracts the JSON from the AI response and merges with the original job data. Rejects jobs where decision=reject.

nodes.name: Async Content Filter
nodes.notes: Assigns async_level (high/medium/low/unknown) and removes jobs requiring fixed US/EU hours.

nodes.name: Role Fit and Score
nodes.notes: Scores each job 0-100 across Taiwan eligibility (40pts), async fit (25pts), role fit (25pts), salary fit (10-25pts). Adds role_category and why_good_fit fields.

nodes.name: IF Score 70 or Above
nodes.notes: Routes jobs: score >= 70 → Filtered Jobs sheet. Score < 70 → Rejected sheet.

nodes.name: Write Filtered Jobs
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Set documentId to your Google Sheet ID. Appends qualifying jobs to 'Filtered Jobs' sheet.

nodes.name: Write Rejected Jobs
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Set documentId to your Google Sheet ID. Appends rejected jobs to 'Rejected' sheet.

nodes.name: IF Score 85 or Above
nodes.notes: Routes high-scoring jobs (>= 85) to cover letter drafting + instant alert.

nodes.name: Prepare Cover Letter Prompt
nodes.notes: Builds a tailored cover letter prompt for jobs scoring 85+.

nodes.name: Draft Cover Letter
nodes.notes: Calls OpenAI to generate a tailored cover letter for high-scoring jobs. Uses gpt-4o for better writing quality.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o', temperature: 0.7, max_tokens: 500, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json._cover_letter_prompt }] }) }}

nodes.name: Save Cover Letter and Send Alert
nodes.notes: Extracts cover letter text from OpenAI response and merges with original job data for the alert email.

nodes.name: Send High Score Alert
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Set up Gmail OAuth2 credential. Sends instant alert for jobs scoring 85+.

nodes.name: Build Daily Digest
nodes.notes: Aggregates ALL scored jobs (connected directly from Role Fit and Score node) to build the daily digest email. Runs in parallel with the IF routing branch.

nodes.name: Send Daily Digest
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Set up Gmail OAuth2 credential. Sends the full daily digest at the end of the workflow run.

main.node: Save Cover Letter and Send Alert

meta.description:
Daily job hunter for Taiwan-eligible async remote roles. Searches 8 sources, hard-filters by location restrictions, runs AI eligibility check via OpenAI, scores each job 0-100, writes to Google Sheets, and sends a Gmail digest at 8:30 AM Taiwan time.

SETUP REQUIRED:
1. Google Sheets: Create sheet with 4 tabs: 'Raw Jobs', 'Filtered Jobs', 'Applied', 'Rejected'
2. Replace all REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID with your actual Sheet ID (from the URL)
3. Create Google Sheets OAuth2 credential in n8n and replace REPLACE_WITH_CREDENTIAL_ID
4. Create OpenAI API credential in n8n and replace REPLACE_WITH_OPENAI_CREDENTIAL_ID
5. Create Gmail OAuth2 credential in n8n and replace REPLACE_WITH_GMAIL_CREDENTIAL_ID
6. For Wellfound, YC, and Otta: consider replacing with Apify actors for reliable scraping
7. Test run manually before activating — check each node output in turn
